title: Tempban

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Hello,

I was spectating you at the time, and it was clear that you killed your teammate on purpose. Your teammate was trying to cross a bridge, and you kept breaking the glass that he was stepping on.

You will have to wait two days for your tempban to expire.

Regards,
MLGPorky, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
